name: Gardening Tools
description: Gardening tools word search puzzles focus on the shed and the soil — trowel, pruner, rake, hoe, cultivator, wheelbarrow and cold frame — for adults who like the practical side of the garden as much as the flowers. Play free online on any phone, tablet or computer. Easy grids keep words across and down; medium adds diagonals; hard allows all eight directions; large print enlarges the letters for comfortable reading. Lists are brand-free hand-tool English, a companion to our Garden and Tools themes rather than a catalogue of store names. No timer, no score and no account. If you are new here, see how to play; if type feels small, open a large-print gardening puzzle first, then browse Flowers, Trees and Herbs for a full garden afternoon.
